craft_notes: Sthāyin: field-lord (experiencer enthroned). Rows: row 3 (worshipable→praise). Close: praise (boon-granter before it: siddhida). Rejected: 'protector' for field-lord — killed: field-lord kept (kṣetrapati as office, not role); 'thirty-six' spelled out — killed: thirty-six-truth kept hyphenated (the count sings).

lines: In six views adorable, thirty-six-truth-filled, self-named ever,
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaḍdarśaneṣu pūjyaṃ ṣaḍtriṃśattattvasaṃvalitam | ātmābhikhyaṃ satataṃ kṣetrapatiṃ siddhidaṃ vande

reads_against.argmap: Who guards the field? → Kṣetrapati as first-person-experiencer (ātman), 36-tattva-bodied, worshipped in all six systems, protector on all sides.
c1_essence: Kṣetrapati self-named, 36-reality-infused, worshipped in six views: the experiencer guards the field.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder circling home to rest)
